safetyRationale: XNBUA uses the exact prototype land fill for BUAARE areas only, including the existing Night brightness normalization. This intentionally supersedes the prior shore-fill distinction: built-up fill matches LANDA while remaining distinct from every water/depth role. BUAARE classification, geometry, LANDF boundaries, labels and priorities remain unchanged. CHBRN and all hazard uses are unchanged. XNGEO applies prototype chart-text ink only to OBJNAM in the 18 pinned BUAARE/LNDARE/LNDRGN/SEAARE lookup records; other label attributes and all navigational feature labels remain unchanged. The HTML defines no complete ENC depth-area palette. Explicit additional shades retain the pinned deep/medium/shallow/very-shallow/intertidal distinctions; safety contour and safety soundings remain distinct. Day CHBLK/CHGRD retain pinned dark ink for shallow-area contrast. Dusk uses prototype floating text and Night uses prototype chart text for general monochrome ink. Baked Dusk/Night sheets change only pixels matching Day neutral ink, reviewed theme neutral RGB and identical alpha (42100 pixels each). SCRUM-244 separately places the exact prototype ACHARE51 service anchor in a proven unreferenced transparent 20x20 tile at (20,1160), with pivot (10,10) preserving the geographic hotspot and prototype 27/32 scale. Only the final RCID1105 bitmap location, size and pivot plus 126 new pixels per theme change; the old tile remains intact. Day/Dusk use prototype service ink; Night applies its chart brightness 0.78. SCRUM-251 changes only line-style RCID2012 CBLSUB06 color-ref from ACHMGD to AXNCBL using prototype mark-area hue, including the prototype Night chart brightness 0.78. Its HPGL/width/pivot/origin and all cable lookups remain unchanged; global CHMGD, other line styles, restricted-area/ferry/dump boundaries and chromatic buoy/light roles remain pinned. All other pixels, symbols, lookups and conditional symbology are unchanged. SCRUM-253 normalizes Night LANDA/XNBUA/CSTLN/DEPDW/DEPMD/DEPMS/DEPVS/DEPIT/DEPCN/XNGEO by the chart-only brightness 0.78 once. CHBLK/CHGRD, their neutral raster pixels, DEPSC and SNDG1/SNDG2 retain brighter navigation ink: full dimming would break existing 4/2/3 water/shallow/land contrast guards. Factory LIGHTS descriptions keep CHBLK in Night while their halo follows effective DEPDW; geographic OBJNAM uses effective XNGEO. Already-effective cable and anchor are unchanged. Native real-ENC hazard review is mandatory before acceptance.
